tags: from Accra, Ghana; signed with Croatian side HNK Sibenik before moving to the US
35 apps, 2 goals, 1 assist for Sibenik (from Feb 2024), led the squad in minutes (2,971) in 2024/25
signed by Crown Legacy FC (Charlotte's MLS NEXT Pro side) 30 Jul 2025, elevated to Charlotte FC first team
made MLS debut at LA Galaxy (28 Feb, halftime sub), then an ever-present starter
named to MLS Team of the Matchday (Matchday 14) with a standout game: 91% pass accuracy, 86% ground duels won, 83% aerial duels won

off_pitch.notes: Charlotte FC ran a feature profile on him, 'Meet Morrison: The Boy From Accra,' documenting his path from Ghana through Croatia to MLS.
